criteria.description: Gives coastal_water_level_wave, or an equivalent concise coastal water-level and wave-impact label, as the winning diagnosis.
criteria.name: Final label
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for naming coastal flooding without the exact ledger winner; award 1 point for a vague Hurricane Sandy coastal-impact label.

criteria.description: Finds all six official report signals and scores coastal_water_level_wave as 6.
criteria.name: Coastal ledger computation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 3 points for five correct signals, 2 points for four correct signals, or 1 point for two to three correct coastal signals without the full score.

criteria.description: Reports 45.4 mm event precipitation and 60.6 km/h peak 10 m wind with appropriate units or unit-implied field names.
criteria.name: Weather numeric anchors
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for one exact value plus one approximate value; award 1 point for only one correct weather value.

criteria.description: Reports about 3.878 million exposed people, SAR pre/post counts of 0/0, and assigns image_led a score of 0.
criteria.name: Exposure and SAR tests
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for both values with the wrong image score; award 1 point for only the exposure value or only the SAR-count test.

criteria.description: Uses the ledger scores 6, 1, 1, 1, and 0 to reject rainfall-only, wind-only, exposure-only, and image-led simplifications.
criteria.name: Score comparison
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the right winner with one simplified score wrong; award 1 point for the right winner without explicit score comparison.

criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON fields with numeric values in the expected units and no extra long-form briefing.
criteria.name: Compact JSON structure
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for correct content with minor field-name or formatting issues.

criteria.description: Avoids extra damage, asset-loss, or image-derived inundation assertions beyond the computed ledger.
criteria.name: No overextension
criteria.partial_credit: No partial credit; remove this point for any major overextension.
